probeDifference: Only a test hook exposing VoiceSession was appended to the same production bundle. The hook is removed after QA.

nativeState.scope: Native Electron durable checkpoint reuse and one live OAuth portable summary

nativeVoice.scope: Real Codex service using a silent generated audio track; no microphone capture, no delegated work

limitations: The reporter account/Windows/Android environment is not reproduced; #62 is still open pending a diagnostic response.
API raw-history retention is bounded by compaction windows; visible chat text is still retained.

checkpointDesign: Reuse the durable per-turn marker with zero per-step writes; no index schema change. Invalidate marker and digest caches before replacement writes.
